text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, with a resolve strong enough to repel 
the scorching sun. It was a wonderful 
summer. And now—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: This is where we say goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Sei-chan, King-chan, and I are heading to 
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass and I are heading—to the Mainichi 
Okan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Do you realize, El? Just who it is we are 
trying to challenge?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... A magnificent champion. Someone 
no one can catch up to..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I will catch up. ...She is the 
ocean. Beyond her lies the Japan Cup!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I won't wish you good luck, El. She isn't 
an opponent you can fight while showing 
sympathy.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I... I'm going to beat both of them! 
Suzuka-senpai and Grass!

A three-way clash between the champion and 
the challengers. This autumn looks to be 
an even fiercer battle than imagined.
